caption:

beats.say: If you still pay six dollars for a habit app, stop scrolling.
Loop tracks your habits, with streaks and charts, and it's free.
Streaks charges six dollars on iPhone. Loop is zero on Android.
Tick off a habit every day and watch your streaks build.
Charts show your score, your history, and your best streaks.
No ads, no accounts, and no in-app purchases.
It even works offline, and your data stays on your phone.
Comment Habit, and I'll send you the link.
